roadmap.title: Play the story and save the party
roadmap.description: Complete the main quests and Jesse sightings. Start Langston’s side quests when available and use the correct karaoke lyrics in The Party Won’t Stop. Open upgrade crates and spend resources as you progress. Assist Mode can be enabled without blocking achievements.

roadmap.title: Finish side quests and upgrades
roadmap.description: Defeat the remaining Resonants, finish the required side quests, and collect the Sketchbook pages and Secret Hideouts. Complete FBC Tasks, raise every Zone to level 5, and finish the combat and crafting goals. Free roam remains available after the ending.

achievements.description: Finish the Mural in the Gap by defeating all six Resonants and the Hedron.
achievements.summary: Finish the Mural in the Gap by defeating all six Resonants and the Hedron.

steps.text: Defeat the Resonants in @loc{Downtown}, @loc{Central}, @loc{West Incursion Zone}, @loc{The Park}, @loc{Underpass}, and @loc{The Unknown}.
Defeat @enemy{the Hedron} to finish the Mural. Any remaining regional Resonants can also be defeated after the ending.
Finish the final battle and platforming sequence in @mechanic{Fight the Core}.
Create Gravity Wells with @mechanic{Pope’s Research} relays to cross @loc{The Unknown}.
Finish @mechanic{Sever the Hedron Links}.
Complete @mechanic{The Hedron Link}.
Complete the Jesse sightings required by the story through @mechanic{The House in Distress}.

achievements.description: Help the CFD during Enemy of My Enemy.
achievements.summary: Help the CFD during Enemy of My Enemy.

steps.text: Complete the main quest @mechanic{Enemy of My Enemy}.
Finish @mechanic{Evacuation Procedures} in the @loc{Evacuation Zone}.
Use @mechanic{Pope’s Research} relays to reach the southern @loc{Evac Building} island in @loc{The Unknown}. Take its Gravity Well to the northern @loc{Field Office} island.
Defeat the enemies to free four soldiers and open the path.
At the four sheds, strike the glowing shed whose timing differs from the others. Do this four times.
Follow the path left of the next locked door. Carry electricity through the intermediate power cube to the door before the charge expires.
Go upstairs in the next building and cross the rooftops to the right. Clear the plaza, then use the next building’s elevator to reach the Resonant.
Defeat the Resonant and leave @loc{The Gap}.
Inspect @loc{The Spire} from northeast of the @loc{Underpass} fast travel door to add its quest.
Climb the Spire with @mechanic{Gravity Shift}. Collect the three keys from the floating islands left, right, and opposite the locked boss door.
Open the door, defeat the Resonant, and leave @loc{The Gap}.
Enter @loc{The Park} through @loc{The Park Checkpoint} in northeast Central. Eat the Mold in the central hole marked “New Mold strains?”.
Reach the @loc{Pizzeria} through the northwest Sewers. Defeat the enemies and eat its Mold.
Clear the enemies at the southwest @loc{Minimart} and northwest @loc{Gym}, then eat the Mold in each building.
Return to the central hole, enter the newly opened Mold Door, and defeat the Resonant. Leave @loc{The Gap} to receive the achievement.
At @loc{Central’s Patterned Factory}, inspect the south wall’s @item{Patterned Pipes}.
Break through the rooftop door and take the elevator to the bottom floor.
Defeat the Resonant, then leave @loc{The Gap}.

achievements.description: Defeat the West Incursion Zone Resonant.
achievements.summary: Defeat the West Incursion Zone Resonant.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{The Incursion Fault} to learn @mechanic{Gravity Shift}.
At the long gap before the @loc{West Incursion Zone} theater, shift onto the building to your left. Follow that route to the theater.
Defeat the Resonant inside, then leave @loc{The Gap}.
Defeat @enemy{The Artist} during @mechanic{Orientation}, then leave @loc{The Gap}.
Purchase @mechanic{Primary Form} and @mechanic{Secondary Form} upgrades at the metal pillar in @loc{The Gap}.
After maxing your preferred Forms, buy upgrades for other Forms until @mechanic{Aberrant Strength} reaches 100. Prioritize upgrades worth +3 or +5 Strength.
If materials run short, complete side quests and World Feats or buy materials from vendors whose Zone Level requirements you meet.
Earn @item{Talent Points} by raising Zone levels. Visit @loc{The Gap} and buy 30 Talents from the small stone circle.
Open the Health Upgrade crate in each of the six @loc{Secret Hideouts}.
Find six more Health Upgrade pieces in the large clown crates marked on your map as you approach. Twelve pieces complete four upgrades.
Complete quests, World Feats, and enemy encounters across Manhattan to raise Zone levels. Each new level grants a Zone Upgrade; reach 40 upgrades in total.
Collect the Power Upgrade crate in each of the six @loc{Testing Facilities}.
Open six more large metal Power Upgrade crates during quests and exploration. Twelve pieces complete four upgrades.

achievements.description: Equip Combat Abilities in all six slots.
achievements.summary: Equip Combat Abilities in all six slots.

steps.text: Defeat the regional Resonants to unlock Combat Abilities, and finish @mechanic{Pope’s Research} for its @item{Resonant Token}.
Use the Mural in @loc{The Gap} to fill all six Combat Ability slots across both sets of three.
Collect Artifact recipes and materials from quests, crates, enemies, and vendors.
Craft at the small well in @loc{The Gap} until you reach 30 Artifacts. Crafting the same Artifact repeatedly counts.
Speak to the unmarked agent outside @loc{Central’s Field Office} to unlock @mechanic{FBC Tasks}.
Take jobs from the Taskboard in each Zone and finish any 20. More jobs become available as the story advances.
Collect clothing rewards from main quests, side quests, Resonant fights, and @mechanic{SHÜM} games. Buy any extra pieces from Zone vendors until you own 12 outfit items.

achievements.description: Contain Altered Items and help Langston.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Altered Item side quests for Langston.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Into the Valley of Death}, followed by @mechanic{Panopticon Service Request}, before finishing the story. Also finish @mechanic{Freeze Frame}, @mechanic{A New Directive}, @mechanic{The Party Won’t Stop}, and @mechanic{The Complete Set} on that same save.

For @mechanic{Freeze Frame}, finish the Jesse sightings and equip @mechanic{Ground Slam} from the West Incursion Resonant plus @mechanic{Ignite} or @mechanic{Inferno} from the Central Resonant. Approach cameras from behind and take their photos. If spotted, walk away until you hear the reset click, then retry.

In @loc{Downtown}, reach the first camera’s roof from the northwest street using Shift and break its rooftop barrier with Ground Slam. For the other, relay electricity from the station north of the camera through the northeast roof to its rear door.

In @loc{Central}, descend from Watchtower into the open storage room, climb the scaffolds, and use the ceiling hole to drop behind one camera. At the other rooftop camera, pass it once, open the street-level door downstairs, reset the camera, and return through that door.

In @loc{West Incursion Zone}, shift at the street west of the platform camera and jump onto its floating platforms from inverted gravity. For the far northwest camera, use Reach to get onto the roof above the sideways building, then drop behind the camera.

In @loc{Evacuation Zone}, relay electricity from the southeast station along the road near “Unauthorized mines?”, through the street cube and the cube below the elevator. Use Reach to carry it to the rooftop camera’s rear door. At the other camera, pass it, take the building’s elevator down, exit to reset, and return by elevator.

In @loc{The Park}, enter @loc{Nomand Avenue Station} north of the camera, take the left path, and burn the web barrier. For the camera above the sewers, power the lift west of it with electricity from the cube on the southern street near the wardrobe icon.

In @loc{Underpass}, stay left of the northeast island’s yellow corridor, use Reach at the lower grapple point, and drop through the floor hole behind the camera. For the camera south of Tubes Island, shift along the red floor to the wall opening opposite the camera, then drop across into its opening.

Open routes across @loc{The Unknown} with @mechanic{Pope’s Research} Gravity Wells. Enter the construction building and defeat the basement Mold ambush to reach the camera behind the blue Mold opening. Flip gravity if you are on the wrong street. For the shop camera, pass it, open the garage with the red button, reset, and return through the garage.
After all 14 cameras, answer the call and return to the marked @loc{Downtown} area. Disable the remaining cameras from behind without being seen; being spotted resets this final group.
Complete @mechanic{The Party Won’t Stop} at the southwest West Incursion apartment party. Use the karaoke choices in @mechanic{Be What You Want to Be} to save every attendee.

Start @mechanic{The Complete Set} from the phone in the first apartment on the second floor of the western Central building. Chase the speaker near the bins across the street and catch it when it pauses.
At the southern West Incursion @loc{Museum of Curiosities}, follow the red lines and destroy the three Hiss orbs blocking entry. Read the front-desk note, press the red button, and catch the speaker.
Clear the rooftop enemies at @loc{Downtown’s Auction House} in Dense Patterning. Speak to the balcony occupant, catch the speaker, and collect the balcony note and recording near the couches.

Read the note in the third-floor @loc{Auction Buyer’s Apartment} in eastern Central. Clear the coffee shop to the west and catch its speaker. Ask Langston for the storage keycard, then take the second Oldest House elevator to @loc{Executive Research}. Open the SR door on the left, fight the Hiss, and catch the subwoofer.

At the Auction House, use the couch on the civilian’s right to set down the captured speakers. Place one speaker on each surface: glass above the black boxes below the stairs; black stone on the north stage; wooden bench upstairs near the generators; blue tarp on the other upstairs ledge. Put the subwoofer in the water beside the console operator.
Speak to the console operator, turn off the four speakers, and turn off the subwoofer to finish @mechanic{The Complete Set}.

For @mechanic{A New Directive}, create Gravity Wells with @mechanic{Pope’s Research} and visit the northwest and southwest Unknown islands to receive both calls. Speak to Fred in @loc{Central’s Cafeteria}, then Langston. Fred is also called Fra Mauro. Tell Fra @mechanic{You call Jesse ‘Roosa’} followed by @mechanic{You’re looking for Jesse?}.

Report to Langston and inspect the desk in the @loc{Director’s Office}. Furnish the container south of Langston. Put both plastic chairs before the desk and the sofa chair behind it. Set the fan and light on the desktop and the two traffic cones behind the desk.
Speak to Fra and choose @mechanic{Is it a Portrait}. Take a Jesse portrait from the Field Office, bring it to Fra to repaint, and hang it on the container’s back wall.
Speak to Fra and Langston, then tell Zoe at @loc{Watchtower} about Fred. Use the radio beside Zoe, then the panel beside the container door to trap Fra.

During @mechanic{Recursions and Iterations}, Pope starts @mechanic{Into the Valley of Death}. Get the apartment keys from Langston. Enter the @loc{Sinkhole} through the laundromat, reach the Personal Access platform, and follow the yellow tape past the number 3 to apartment 5.
Inspect the scratches and blood in Langston’s apartment. Put the feeder in the bedroom’s carrier and carry it along the fallen plants and cat footprints.
In the lit apartment south of Dombrow, put the carrier on the bed near the TV. Play the piano, remove all four plants from the bedroom, and leave until Langston calls you back.
Collect the carrier, inspect Dombrow’s body, and follow the blood and Alfred’s directions deeper into the Sinkhole. Drop through the central hole and head south to the red wall crack to fight Maria.

Place the carrier at the crack. Call Alfred to a window just ahead of the moving red light on the same wall. Catch Maria this way three times, defeat her again, then leave the carrier beside the TV near the Ranger’s body.

Ask Langston at @loc{Central’s Field Office} for @mechanic{Panopticon Service Request}. Put the two computer racks back beside the security console; find one directly right and the other in the southwest corner. Put the eastern satellite dish on the pillar with the blinking red light and use the terminal.
Inspect cell @loc{B-02} and tell Langston @mechanic{Category D}, then @mechanic{The number is 04}. Take the radio from the opened cell.

Wait for the radio broadcast about the @mechanic{World’s Fair}, then carry the radio into cell @loc{E-05} to finish. If the quest is unavailable after the ending, load an earlier main-quest save. All six related quests and their collectibles must be completed on that same save; redo any that are missing.

achievements.displayName: Be What You Want to Be
achievements.description: Keep everyone alive during the karaoke performance.
achievements.summary: Keep everyone alive during the karaoke performance.

steps.text: Go to the music in southwest @loc{West Incursion Zone} to start @mechanic{The Party Won’t Stop}. Jump from the higher street east of the marker to the roof and enter the rooftop door.
Start the karaoke machine. Choose @mechanic{gasoline}, @mechanic{stress}, and @mechanic{so fleeting}.
Choose @mechanic{too long}, @mechanic{move}, and @mechanic{fear}.
Finish with @mechanic{everything}, @mechanic{higher and higher}, and @mechanic{Shout}.
If anyone dies, use @mechanic{Settings > Load Game} to restore a save from before the performance and retry. Older main-quest saves also let you return to the party.

achievements.description: Deal with all the Thresholds in Manhattan.
achievements.summary: Finish all three Manhattan Threshold side quests.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Unsupervised Science} by entering a Testing Facility. Find the six facilities through: the ground-floor pipe at @loc{Downtown’s Deserted Area} construction site; the pit southeast of @loc{Central’s Patterned Factory}; and the pipe below @loc{Survivalist’s Bunker} via the parking garage near “Unauthorized mines?” in the Evacuation Zone.

Find the remaining facilities through the construction pit on the central road in @loc{West Incursion Zone}; the eastern @loc{Park Sewer Route}, heading southeast and then northeast at lava level; and the construction pit west of @loc{Twisted Rooftops} in The Unknown.

In Downtown, West Incursion Zone, and Evacuation Zone, carry each of the five objects across floor lines until it becomes a soda machine. Put one machine in each square; Evacuation Zone has one square upstairs and four downstairs.
In Central, The Park, and The Unknown, start the 60-second charge test. Move charges from blinking blue cores into red cores before they overload, until every core turns green.
After each experiment, use the switch by the computer icon and collect the Power Upgrade crate. If Downtown’s switch stays inactive, pick up its nearby audio log.
After all six experiments, use the switch in the Unknown facility’s Power Upgrade room. Enter the opened Threshold and collect the recording beside the body at the end.
For @mechanic{The Last Taxi}, inspect a taxi, enter its right passenger door, and answer the phone in the Threshold. Complete one taxi in each Zone.

Find @loc{Downtown’s} taxi on the main road north of the deserted road checkpoint. Choose the taxi with the lit roof sign, then the sign that stays lit as you approach, then the sign currently lit while the lights cycle.
At @loc{Central’s} main-road taxi, choose by lights in this order: roof sign only; headlights, taillights, and roof sign; roof sign only; all three again.
Find the @loc{Evacuation Zone} taxi in the laser-filled alley west of Evac Building. Choose the taxi flashing opposite the others, then the one flashing twice, then the one that does not flash.

Find the @loc{West Incursion Zone} taxi on the upside-down wall southwest of Empire Avenue. Choose the taxi under the flashing streetlight, then the non-flashing streetlight, then the light flashing opposite the others.

Find @loc{The Park’s} taxi in the garage southwest of Mold Factory: climb the blue Mold at the northwest street corner to the vendor’s roof, then drop one floor. Clear Mold and fit the trunk and hood; next fit the yellow hood and two wheels; finally fit the fender, hood, and roof light from behind-left and the trunk and rear bumper from the right.

Find the @loc{Underpass} taxi in the northeast corner of the Mold-filled room reached after the cable car. Choose the taxi whose lights stay on, then the one whose headlights and taillights go off when the lights flicker, then the taxi with no lights while the streetlights are on.

Find @loc{The Unknown’s} taxi north of Evac Building. In each of its three rounds, shine the portable light at the cars and choose the taxi that casts a matching taxi shadow. After the seventh taxi, answer the phone once more.

Start @mechanic{Crossing the Threshold} at the garage west of @loc{Central’s Field Office}. Inspect the body and security camera, then use @mechanic{Next Screen > Interact} on the nearby Security Station computer.

Inspect the @loc{Field Hospital} and its green cabinet. Use the computer in the third-floor @loc{Security Station} south of the hospital and select @mechanic{Next screen} twice. Return to the cabinet and take the quarantine list.

At the @loc{Dig Site}, report the body, collect the nearby clues, report to Zoe again, and take the body’s @item{Mobile Research Station Keycard}. Open the TE-clearance room to the north and collect its recording and note.
Clear the warehouse northeast of the Dig Site and speak to Wilson. Agree to host @mechanic{AVP-3}, receive it from the seated person, then stand in the yellow square at the Dig Site to release it.
After @mechanic{The Hedron Link}, cut down the research balloon on the starting island of @loc{The Unknown}. Break its dropped crate to release the probe relays.
Carry each relay to the red circle indicated by its minimap signal and beeping. Place the relay so its light turns green.
Use the resulting Gravity Well to reach the central island and reveal its map. Complete all eight balloon sites shown on the map, using their wells to travel between islands.

For @mechanic{Investigate Point 0}, take the Gravity Well on the southern @loc{Evac Building} island toward the central sphere. Use @mechanic{Gravity Shift} to latch onto the sphere as you pass through.
Inspect inside the sphere until Dylan falls out and the quest ends.

achievements.description: Complete all instances of the Sketchbook.

guide.context: Finish the Jesse sightings to unlock the traversal abilities. Inspect each scene to mark its loose props, arrange them, then inspect again to draw the page. Track completed pages in Archives > Collectibles > Dylan’s Sketchbook.

collectibles.name: Beach Day
collectibles.location: Construction site at Lookout Point.
collectibles.method: Inspect the blue tarp. Put the two beach chairs beside each other facing forward and place the umbrella behind them.

collectibles.name: Rooftop Oasis
collectibles.location: Northwest rooftop marked Dense Patterning.
collectibles.method: Use Reach to reach the roof. Inspect the table, put the three swans nearest it on the spots without stones, and put the three plants on the outer spots with stones.

collectibles.name: The Cat Picnic
collectibles.location: Yard beside a blue house in the eastern half of the Zone.
collectibles.method: Inspect the picnic tarp. Put the basket at the front left, the black cat at the back right, and the ginger cat at the back middle.

collectibles.name: Live on Stage
collectibles.location: Southwest building with the black FBC vehicle outside; first door left after climbing the first stairs.
collectibles.method: Inspect the instruments. Put the blue guitar on the left, the keyboard in the middle, the drum in the right corner, the brown guitar on the right, and the microphone on its stand.

collectibles.name: Halloween Party
collectibles.location: Rooftops immediately beyond West Incursion Zone Checkpoint.
collectibles.method: Use Reach to reach the table. The small pumpkin belongs at the front left. Put the ghost behind it, the large pumpkins at the back right, and the skeleton at the front right.

collectibles.name: Dream House
collectibles.location: Rooftop of Railyard Street Station in the north; stairs inside the Mold-infested building.
collectibles.method: Inspect the playhouse and collect its six marked pieces on the roof. Assemble the house, checking the different colors and textures of the front wall and roof.

collectibles.name: Robotics
collectibles.location: Southwest building; enter at the alley’s far end or through the roof.
collectibles.method: Inspect the vending machine. Attach the four marked pipes to the machine and place the head on top.

collectibles.name: The Dragon and the Knight Sketch
collectibles.location: Park Valley Station in the northwest; street entrance southeast of the sketch.
collectibles.method: Inspect the dragon-shaped Mold. Put the two tools in its mouth, the two benches along its sides, and the two cones on its back.

collectibles.name: Space Adventure
collectibles.location: Top of the island reached by jumping from Research Site.
collectibles.method: Inspect the moon landing scene. Put the antenna on the yellow X, alien on the wooden box, white-clothed boy on the lowest podium, brown-clothed person on the highest podium, and US flag on the middle podium.

collectibles.name: Art Exhibition
collectibles.location: Street-level art gallery; flip gravity if the map marker leads to the opposite street.
collectibles.method: Inspect the empty pedestals. From left to right, place the bowl, toilet, laptop, and vacuum. The laptop and vacuum change appearance after placement.

collectibles.name: Game Night
collectibles.location: Bottom floor of the building under construction on the southeast island; open the route with Pope’s Research Gravity Wells.
collectibles.method: Inspect the board game table. Place its three nearby figurines in the center in any order. Find a candle on the supermarket’s left shelf, a pizza in the pizzeria, and a mannequin in the laundromat reached by shifting on the road. Put the candle on the table’s left, pizza at the right corner, and mannequin on the right.

achievements.summary: Befriend the dog by finishing Every Dog Has Her Day.

collectibles.name: Downtown dog
collectibles.location: Southwest rooftop.
collectibles.method: Bring the blue dragon toy from the neighboring roof on the left back to the dog.

collectibles.name: Central dog
collectibles.location: Eastern rooftop.
collectibles.method: Retrieve the toy from the end of the alley below, in the direction the dog faces.

collectibles.name: West Incursion Zone dog
collectibles.location: Northwest rooftop reached with Gravity Shift.
collectibles.method: Retrieve the toy from the next roof in the direction the dog faces.

collectibles.name: Evacuation Zone dog
collectibles.location: Northern rooftop.
collectibles.method: Use Gravity Shift to reach the upside-down roof directly above the dog. Take the toy and shift back to return it.

collectibles.name: Park dog
collectibles.location: Northeast corner, beside the roof with the yellow lift.
collectibles.method: Take electricity from the Power Core Station west of the dog. Store it in the power boxes through the doors on the roof halfway to the dog, then relay it to the lift. Ride up, collect the toy, and return it.

collectibles.name: Underpass dog
collectibles.location: Platform between Halfway Trail and Research Site.
collectibles.method: Use Shift and Reach to reach the dog. Look for the white radiator beside a pillar with orange pipes. Jump off that radiator and shift onto the opposite ceiling to collect the toy. While jumping back toward the dog, drop the toy so gravity pulls it across. Use Reach at the side ledge to return, pick up the toy, and give it to the dog.

collectibles.name: Unknown dog
collectibles.location: Northwest island, reached using Pope’s Research Gravity Wells.
collectibles.method: Look toward the skyscraper the dog faces. Shift up the neighboring building, jump across near the skyscraper’s top, and retrieve the toy.

collectibles.name: Final visit
collectibles.location: The Gap, after returning the toy in all seven Zones.
collectibles.method: Return to The Gap after all seven toy deliveries. Use the interaction prompt beside the dog to finish the quest.

guide.context: Hideouts can be visited in any order. Each contains a Health Upgrade crate; open it while you are inside.

collectibles.name: Downtown hideout
collectibles.location: Atlantis Restaurant, green street entrance.
collectibles.method: Inspect the wall box at the back right. Activate the radio, dark coffee maker, white coffee maker, soda machine, microwave, and fridge in that order. Enter the opened room.

collectibles.name: Central hideout
collectibles.location: Wear’Em & Wash’Em laundromat.
collectibles.method: If the entrance is sealed, follow its red lines and destroy the linked objects. Number the six machine columns left to right: turn on the available machines in columns 1–3; turn everything off in columns 4–5; in column 6 turn on only the machine nearest the door. Enter the secret room.

collectibles.name: West Incursion Zone hideout
collectibles.location: Urban Fresh mart, street entrance.
collectibles.method: Enter 1213 on the cash register and enter the hidden room.

collectibles.name: Evacuation Zone hideout
collectibles.location: Street-level art gallery.
collectibles.method: Choose the middle light on each front pillar and the left light on each back pillar. Enter the opening in the left corner.

collectibles.name: Park hideout
collectibles.location: Atlantis restaurant, street entrance.
collectibles.method: Enter BDAC on the cash register and enter the hidden room.

collectibles.name: Unknown hideout
collectibles.location: Pulse Fitness, beneath the purple shop sign.
collectibles.method: If you find an art gallery instead, shift to the opposite-gravity street. First use the treadmill set to 0.5 MPH, then the bike set to 15 MPH. Activate the vending machine, then the treadmill set to 15 MPH, then the bike set to 0.5 MPH. Enter the hidden room.

achievements.description: Deal with the major Mold Incidents in Manhattan.
achievements.summary: Finish New Growth and all three Carbon Copy quests.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{New Growth} with the soldier on @loc{The Park’s FBC Base} roof. Read the letter on the small roof south of the base, then the note in Underhill’s Level 6 office upstairs in @loc{Central Executive}.

Find Underhill in the northeast Park apartment building, first door left upstairs. Enter the underground laboratory outside and around the left corner, collect the equipment, and inspect the white Mold.
Follow and defeat all three marked test subjects, then return to Underhill.

For @mechanic{Carbon Copy I}, speak to Heidi in the pink jacket in the central Park building. Enter the apartment building to the south through its roof, speak to Hannah downstairs on the left, and return to Heidi.

After Zoe calls to begin @mechanic{Carbon Copy II}, visit the @loc{Field Hospital} and speak to Dr. Florez. Speak to Hannah in the medical unit around the corner and read the file on the back bed. Search the sisters’ apartment bathroom.

Check the apartment rooftop to begin @mechanic{Carbon Copy III}. Find Heidi beside the northern Park Power Core Station. Enter the door next to Heidi and speak to Hannah inside. Defeat Hannah, then speak to Heidi again.

achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for one Aberrant Form.

steps.text: Use the metal pillar in @loc{The Gap} to purchase every upgrade for one @mechanic{Aberrant Form}.

achievements.summary: Raise every Zone to at least level 5.

steps.text: Check Zone levels on the map. Use quests and World Feats to reach level 5 throughout Manhattan: @loc{Downtown}, @loc{Central}, @loc{West Incursion Zone}, @loc{Evacuation Zone}, @loc{The Park}, @loc{Underpass}, and @loc{The Unknown}.

achievements.summary: Have three Artifacts equipped at once.

steps.text: Craft three @item{Artifacts} from different families at the small well in @loc{The Gap}, then equip them together in @mechanic{Loadout}.

achievements.summary: Use Command on a Breaker enemy.

steps.text: Defeat the @loc{Unknown} Resonant to unlock @mechanic{Command}.
Pick up purple orbs until Command has three charges.
Use Command on a @enemy{Breaker}, such as the Hiss Transporter bus during @loc{Central’s} @mechanic{Hold the Line} World Feat.
Visit @loc{The Gap} and spend one Talent Point on @mechanic{Dominance} at the small stone circle.
Enable @mechanic{Options > Assist Mode > One-Hit Falters}, then activate the training stone beside the Talent circle.
Hit a training enemy and execute the finisher. Keep finishing the respawning enemies for 60 seconds so the white Dominance meter never empties.

achievements.description: Perform 3 Perfect Dodges in less than 6 seconds.
achievements.summary: Perform three Perfect Dodges in under six seconds.

steps.text: Visit @loc{The Gap} and buy @mechanic{Perfect Dodge} from the Talent circle.
Dodge just before an attack hits three times in under six seconds. A flying enemy’s sustained red laser lets you dodge the same beam repeatedly.
For a wider timing window, set @mechanic{Options > Assist Mode > Perfect Dodge Window} to 400.

achievements.description: Enter the Gap three times within five minutes.
achievements.summary: Enter the Gap three times within five minutes.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Enter the Gap} action, leave, and enter again until you have made three visits within five minutes.
Raise a Zone’s level until its @mechanic{SHÜM} Challenge unlocks, then find the joystick icon on the map.
Play a level through to a recorded score. Leaving the game early does not count.

achievements.description: Equip an outfit item in every customization slot.
achievements.summary: Fill every customization slot with clothing or an appearance item.

steps.text: Visit a wardrobe, marked by a jacket icon, at the @loc{Oldest House} or @loc{Evac Building}.

Select an item for each slot: @mechanic{Hair}, @mechanic{Facial Hair}, @mechanic{Body and Face}, @mechanic{Top Layer}, @mechanic{Base Layer}, and @mechanic{Accessories}. Buy glasses from the Downtown vendor if you need an accessory.
Finish a white map activity, for example @mechanic{Hold the Line}.
Speak to the unmarked agent outside @loc{Central’s Field Office} who asks “hey, got a minute?” Advance the story if he is unavailable.
Accept a job from an @mechanic{FBC Taskboard} and finish its listed objective.

achievements.description: Obtain a Health Upgrade or Power Upgrade.
achievements.summary: Complete one full Health Upgrade or Power Upgrade.

steps.text: Open three Health Upgrade crates or three Power Upgrade crates to complete one upgrade.
Complete quests and map activities in one @loc{Zone} until its level reaches 3.
Buy Form upgrades at the metal pillar in @loc{The Gap} until @mechanic{Aberrant Strength} reaches 15.
Purchase a @mechanic{Combo Finisher} at the pillar.
Use the small well in @loc{The Gap} to craft an @item{Artifact} from an @item{Untapped Artifact} and the listed materials.
Visit @loc{The Gap} and buy a Talent from the small stone circle using a @item{Talent Point}.
